Subject: IAM evidence & SOC 2 scoping — next steps

Hi Samantha — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

What we covered:
- High-level scope: Redwood will be a managed inference platform for Vastly Health non-PHI workloads initially; potential for PHI workflows later.
- Compliance: you mentioned Vastly Health is SOC 2 Type II (report available) and has HIPAA controls in place for PHI.
- IAM: primary asks are SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning support (group mapping), RBAC/admin controls for tenant admins, and audit log retention details.

Redwood asks / next steps:
1) Please share the SOC 2 Type II letter (redacted ok) and any HIPAA attestations you can share.
2) Send SAML IdP metadata (xml) or an upload to the Drive link below so our SEs can validate.
3) Provide a sample SCIM group mapping CSV or confirm SCIM v2 support + attributes.
4) Any documentation on RBAC roles and admin controls, including ability to restrict invite/create user flows and role assignment audit logs.
5) If easier, complete the vendor security questionnaire we sent via the portal (link below) — that will speed up procurement.

I attached a short Redwood platform security brief for context. If you can get items 1-3 to us by end of week, our SE (Aditya) can run a quick technical validation and we’ll get procurement aligned. Otherwise happy to schedule a 30-min tech follow-up.

Attachments: redwood_platform_security_brief.pdf (2MB)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-vastly-iam ; https://vendor-portal.redwood.ai/questionnaire/DEAL-3982

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — great call. Attaching our SOC 2 Type II letter and answering the bullets inline below.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Attached (VH-SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf). We completed our latest audit in May 2025.
- HIPAA: We have a business associate framework and can sign an addendum if PHI is in scope later.
- SSO/SAML: We support SAML 2.0; I'll upload the IdP metadata (xml) to your Drive folder and also attach a copy. Our IdP expects the following attributes: uid, email, givenName, sn, groups.
- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 with group provisioning. We'll export a sample group mapping CSV.
- RBAC: We have tenant admin + org admin roles; can provide a role matrix and audit log retention details (logs retained 365 days).

I've started an internal ticket to gather the RBAC matrix and SCIM mapping; security@vastlyhealth.com will follow up with the files this afternoon.

Attachments: VH-SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf (600KB)

Thanks — Samantha

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending the SOC 2 letter and the quick answers. A few technical clarifications to help us validate quickly: 

1) SAML metadata: can you confirm the NameID format you will use (emailAddress vs persistent)? Also, can you include ACS URLs if you have an SP-initiated flow? A raw metadata xml is ideal (we can ingest it into our staging IdP).
2) Attribute mappings: you mentioned groups — are groups in the `groups` attribute as a list, or is group membership derived from a separate SCIM feed? If both available, please provide examples.
3) SCIM provisioning: for group provisioning do you support "group push" or do you only support user->group assignment via SCIM patch? 
4) RBAC matrix: if you can share a CSV with role -> permission mappings (create workspace, invite user, assign role, view audit logs) that will speed the review.

If you can drop the SAML metadata and a sample SCIM mapping into the Drive link Marissa shared, I'll attempt a staging provisioning run tomorrow morning and report back. If there's any concern, please let me know and we can schedule a 30-min technical session (I'm flexible tomorrow 10-12 PT).

I've attached a short IAM evidence checklist to show the items we typically need.

Attachments: iam-evidence-checklist.xlsx (18KB)

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
